preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= m, k <= 100000
preconditions.description: For each test case, m and k are between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: sum(a_i for i in range(1, k+1)) == m
preconditions.description: The sum of all a_i equals m for each test case.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 0 <= a_i <= m
preconditions.description: Each a_i is between 0 and m for each test case.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: n >= ceil(sqrt(m))
postconditions.description: The size of the beautiful matrix n is at least the ceiling of the square root of m.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: n * n >= m
postconditions.description: The total number of cells in the matrix is at least m.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: for each 2x2 submatrix: sum(b[i][j] for i in range(x, x+2) for j in range(y, y+2)) <= 3
postconditions.description: Each 2x2 submatrix contains at most 3 occupied cells.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: for each 2x2 submatrix: b[x][y] != b[x+1][y+1] and b[x][y+1] != b[x+1][y]
postconditions.description: The numbers on each diagonal of a 2x2 submatrix are distinct.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: for each i in range(1, k+1): count(b[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)) == a_i
postconditions.description: Each number i appears exactly a_i times in the matrix.
